name: The Red Lion
headline: Proper pub food in the heart of Wolverhampton
intro: Home-cooked classics, real ales and a warm welcome. Dogs welcome in the bar.
about: The Red Lion has been serving locals for over 50 years. Sunday roasts, live sport and a big beer garden.
hours_note: Kitchen closes 1 hour before the bar.

offers.title: Steak night
offers.text: 2 steaks + a bottle of wine £35, every Thursday

features.title: Beer garden
features.text: Big sunny garden with heaters for colder nights.

features.title: Live sport
features.text: All the big games on 4 screens.

features.title: Dog friendly
features.text: Dogs welcome in the bar area.

menu_note: Please tell us about any allergies when you order.
